categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet internals including `src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Refactors `DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan` locking to use a private non-recursive mutex and defers notification callbacks outside the lock. While this eliminates potential re-entrancy deadlocks as part of #19303, it addresses internal lock hygiene rather than an active user-reported crash or fund-safety defect.
